draft.subject: Getting Bright Collective's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

No worries about missing our kickoff last week — I know launch weeks get busy.

If it's useful, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything else as we go. Just reply with a time that suits you and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
